scope: Team review summaries used as attributed research context, not independent validation of every reviewed claim.

items.statement: VEC provides simulated source and SEEG activity, connectomes and generator-defined EZ hypotheses. It is a development sandbox; fitting and testing against the same generator can be circular.
items.allowed_use: Select the public VEP sandbox and describe its synthetic nature.

items.statement: The reviewed Epileptor-stimulation studies model accumulation of a slow state until seizures are triggered. A stronger response is not evidence of seizure suppression or a better therapeutic target.
items.allowed_use: Interpret the current simulator as diagnostic stimulation response exploration.

items.statement: The team review recommends preserving the dataset gain matrix and separating generator assumptions from inference assumptions. Current agents receive SEEG summaries, not latent x0/EZ values or model accumulation thresholds.
items.allowed_use: Restrict observations and document residual model mismatch; this alone does not establish a blinded localization benchmark.

items.statement: The team review calls for separate development, validation and held-out evaluation patients, and checks for electrode-coverage bias. A one-patient demonstration cannot establish localization accuracy or multi-agent superiority.

The review identifies closed-loop feedback with explicit detection/control latency as a separate therapeutic-stimulation research route. The current open-loop diagnostic model does not implement this feedback controller.
items.allowed_use: Mark a future research direction; do not claim current therapeutic efficacy.
